scope: Independent source inspection and evidence interpretation, not a fresh project/test execution by this round-2 reviewer.

identity_contract_cases.scenario: Fresh attempt and cold restore without validated runtime
identity_contract_cases.observed_scope: Signatures do not take AccountScope/RuntimeGeneration; the concrete adapter methods immediately return full PortError::unconfigured(). Four attempt commands plus restore are exercised.
identity_contract_cases.unproved: Canonical server/user validation, real browser flow, runtime issuance and cold vault restoration.

identity_contract_cases.observed_scope: Unknown settlement is independent from synthetic committed suppression. Exact account, login attempt, N, P, writer and maintenance-transition correlation; wrong account/disposition/request/op rejected. Receipt keeps revision and cannot alone activate.
identity_contract_cases.unproved: Durable SQLite/vault write, current ledger revision and current owner registry.

identity_contract_cases.scenario: Deliberate retain valid named P versus cancel
identity_contract_cases.observed_scope: N=P, missing/wrong P and other-account retention rejected. Synthetic named-P retention preserves the separate P admission despite cancelled replacement; N is not eligible; cancel cannot masquerade as retain/session-only.
identity_contract_cases.unproved: P is synthetically prevalidated. Actual P accessibility, canonical validation and serialization must be enforced by the future owner.

identity_contract_cases.observed_scope: Receipt match fails after cancellation, at exact deadline, after clock epoch change or changed attempt ID.
identity_contract_cases.unproved: Task drop races and native clock delivery.

identity_contract_cases.observed_scope: A runtime token is cancelled and its admission remains closed; maintenance is separately bounded to A and does not carry its cancellation. Wrong account, expiry, epoch change and overflow reject; B remains admitted. Concrete post-closure adapter operations still return Unconfigured.
identity_contract_cases.unproved: Actual server rejection classifier, durable suppression, scheduling, device stop and warnings.

identity_contract_cases.observed_scope: Reconciled, Cleanup and plain Suppressed outcomes cannot produce a session-only receipt, across Unknown/SettledPresent/SettledAbsent. MaintenanceReport has no runtime grant.
identity_contract_cases.unproved: Native writer callbacks, restart/crash ordering, latest-revision rejection and provider settlement proof.

fixture_warning: acknowledgement() explicitly constructs synthetic public CommittedRestoration records using requested disposition. This is test data to exercise correlation, never evidence of an actual transaction. Current-revision/owner checks are required by ADR-003 and port comments, absent in bootstrap.

author_probe.scope: Compiled with rustc against exact source build rlibs and run by author. The source increments count only after assert succeeds. No native I/O. close_publication is no-op because no publisher exists; media stop must return Unconfigured. The probe is outside Cargo tests/Clippy, not CI execution, not 36 repository tests, and not the old independent 27-assertion probe.

future_native_obligations: V.AUTH.STORE/LOSS, provider/ledger fault injection, changed revision and current-registry checks, cancelled/drop delivery and crashes, app-password rejection on both released families, policy/watchdog/media/GPUI/native measurements remain not run. These are not waived.
